title: aspidium thelypteroides
intro: Aspidium thelypteroides, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. The maidenhair fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against cellular damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
